title: Particle Filter
text: Estimate states of discrete-time nonlinear system using particle filter, 4 inputs, 4 outputs, {Covariance} sets Initial covariance of particles; {Function} sets the state transition, {Number of Particles} sets the number of particles used in the filter, {Distribution} sets the initial distribution of particles, {Mean} sets the initial mean value of particles, {Circular Variables} sets the circular variables used for state, {State Orientation} sets the orientation of input system states, {State bounds} sets the initial bounds on system states, {Particles} sets the custom particle distribution for state estimation, {Weights} sets the custom particle weight values for state estimation, {Add Enable Port} enables correction of estimated states only when measured data, {Resampling method} sets the method used for particle resampling, {Trigger method} sets the method to determine when resampling occurs, {Minimum effective particle ratio} sets the minimum desired ratio of the effective number of particles to the total number, {Sampling Interval} sets the fixed interval between resampling, {Randomness} sets the whether the random numbers are repeatable, {Seed}, {Data type}, {Sample time} sets the block sample time, {State Estimation Method} sets the method used for extracting a state estimate, {Output all particles}, {Output weights} sets the output particle weights, {Output state estimation error covariance}, {Use the current measurements to improve state estimates} sets the option to use current measurements for state, {Enable multirate operation} enables specification of different sample times for state transition and measurement likelihood and {Sample times} sets the state transition and measurement likelihood function sample times positive. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: StateTransitionFcnInputs
ports.summary: Optional input argument to state transition function scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: MeasurementLikelihoodFcn1Inputs,...,MeasurementLikelihoodFcn5Inputs
ports.summary: Optional input argument to each measurement likelihood function scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Enable1,Enable2,Enable3,Enable4,Enable5
ports.summary: Enable correction of estimated states when measured data is available scalar

ports.name: Particles
ports.summary: Particle values used for state estimation array

ports.name: Weights
ports.summary: Particle weights used for state estimation vector

params.name: Function
params.values: State transition function name ’vdpParticleFilterStateFcn’ (default) | function name

params.name: Number of Particles
params.values: Number of particles used in the filter 1000 (default) | positive scalar integer

params.name: Distribution
params.values: Initial distribution of particles ’Gaussian’ (default) | ’Uniform’ | ’Custom’

params.name: Mean
params.values: Initial mean value of particles [0;0] (default) | vector

params.name: Covariance
params.values: Initial covariance of particles 1 (default) | scalar | vector | matrix

params.name: Circular Variables
params.values: Circular variables used for state estimation 0 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: State Orientation
params.values: Orientation of input system states ’column’ (default) | ’row’

params.name: State bounds
params.values: Initial bounds on system states [-3 3;-3 3] (default) | array

params.name: Particles
params.values: Custom particle distribution for state estimation [] (default) | array

params.name: Weights
params.values: Custom particle weight values for state estimation [] (default) | vector of positive values

params.name: Add Enable Port
params.values: Enable correction of estimated states only when measured data is available off (default) | on

params.name: Resampling method
params.values: Method used for particle resampling ’Multinomial’ (default) | ’Systemic’ | ’Stratified’

params.name: Trigger method
params.values: Method to determine when resampling occurs ’Ratio’ (default) | ’Interval’

params.name: Minimum effective particle ratio
params.values: Minimum desired ratio of the effective number of particles to the total number of particles 0.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sampling Interval
params.values: Fixed interval between resampling 1 (default) | positive scalar integer

params.name: Randomness
params.values: Whether the random numbers are repeatable ’Repeatable’ (default) | ’Not repeatable’

params.name: Seed
params.values: Seed value for repeatable random numbers 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type for block parameters double (default) | single

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Block sample time 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: State Estimation Method
params.values: Method used for extracting a state estimate from particles ’Mean’ (default) | ’MaxWeight’ | ’None’

params.name: Output all particles
params.values: Output all particles ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Output weights
params.values: Output particle weights ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Output state estimation error covariance
params.values: Output state estimation error covariance ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Use the current measurements to improve state estimates
params.values: Option to use current measurements for state estimation ’on’ (default) | ’off’

params.name: Enable multirate operation
params.values: Enable specification of different sample times for state transition and measurement likelihood functions ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Sample times
params.values: State transition and measurement likelihood function sample times positive scalar
